text:
maria: quick pulse — putting the statelog runway milestone on the board. we need ownership for the kernel KV prefetch change and the batching fallback policy by EOD Friday. who can own each? :hourglass:
ajay: I can take kernel KV prefetch. planning to open a draft PR tonight with perf tests. will need review from taylor on the new eviction heuristics.
taylor: ack. I can review but need the experimental flags to gate it. also let's add a simple perf harness so CI doesn't flake on sequence lengths.
dave: I can own the batching fallback policy. question: do we prefer an autoscale-based fallback or model-variant fallback first? autoscale affects infra costs.
maria: prioritizing availability over cost for the short term — fallback path should be model-variant first (smaller quantized variant), with autoscale as secondary. dave, that matches your plan?
dave: yep. I'll sketch a runbook: 1) model-variant mapping 2) graceful KV flush on switch 3) alert thresholds. posting a PR description tomorrow.
ajay: re KV prefetch — heads-up: the new handshake changes how warmup tokens are appended to KV. sample patch:
```
// prefetch: append warmup prefix only when coldstart
if (is_coldstart) kv.append(prefix);
```
This reduces duplicate KV writes but might change cache miss stats.
taylor: thanks. when you post the draft, include the cache-miss dashboard link. I'll run local sims for 1024 and 2048 seq lengths.
ci-bot: build/4132 started for ajay/kv-prefetch-draft — tests: unit, perf-smoke
maria: dependency note — infra needs a small kernel patch (allocator tweak) before ajay's PR can land. @ops please confirm ETA.
ajay: noted — ops said yesterday they're targeting the allocator tweak on Thursday morning. if that slips we'll canary the prefetch on a single pool.
taylor: timeline check: review by Thu, perf run Thu evening, canary Fri AM, full rollout Fri PM. blocking: allocator tweak + dave's model mapping doc.
dave: I'll push the model mapping doc in ~2h and include migration notes for rollbacks. also adding a short checklist for SLOs to monitor: p50/p95 latency, token throughput, KV miss rate.
maria: perfect. last ask: add a one-line owner field to each PR and a minimal changelog entry. we'll call an async check-in Fri 4pm if everything looks green. :thumbsup:
